title: Google Hotels Scraper input
description: Enter cities or destinations and, optionally, your travel dates. Each hotel found becomes one result with its price per night, rating, reviews and location.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Cities, neighborhoods or destinations, for example "Paris", "Lisbon" or "Times Square, New York". Each location becomes one Google Hotels search.

searchQueries.title: Custom search queries
searchQueries.description: Optional. Free-text Google Hotels searches, for example "hotels near Eiffel Tower" or "pet friendly hotels in Austin". Dates and guests below are added automatically.

checkInDate.title: Check-in date
checkInDate.description: Optional. Format YYYY-MM-DD. Leave both dates empty to use Google's default (tonight, one night).

checkOutDate.title: Check-out date
checkOutDate.description: Optional. Format YYYY-MM-DD. Must be after the check-in date.

maxResultsPerSearch.title: Max hotels per search
maxResultsPerSearch.description: Maximum number of hotels saved for each location or query. Version 1 reads the first Google Hotels results page, which shows about 18-20 hotels. Add more specific locations (neighborhoods, landmarks) to get more hotels.

minRating.title: Minimum guest rating
minRating.description: Optional. Keep only hotels rated at least this much (1-5), for example 4.2.

minStars.title: Minimum star class
minStars.description: Optional. Keep only hotels with at least this hotel class (1-5 stars). Hotels without a star class are left out when this is set.

maxPricePerNight.title: Maximum price per night
maxPricePerNight.description: Optional. Keep only hotels at or below this price per night, in the currency of the results (US dollars with the default proxy).

onlyAvailable.title: Only hotels with a price
onlyAvailable.description: Leave out hotels that show no price for your dates (usually sold out).

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of descriptions and labels, as a Google language code such as en, pt-BR, de or fr.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many searches run at the same time.

maxRetries.title: Max retries per search
maxRetries.description: How many times a search is retried, with an increasing pause and a new proxy IP, when Google answers with an error or an unexpected page.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Google Hotels shows prices in the currency of the visitor's country, so the proxy country sets the currency: United States = US dollars, Germany = euros, United Kingdom = pounds.
